verdict.rationale: Vestd has a dedicated HRIS Integration page that claims you can connect your HR platform and end the manual data shuffle, so a first-party HRIS sync exists. The evidence does not say which HRIS or payroll systems are supported, whether the sync is automatic or recurring, or whether new hires and terminations update equity records. missing for 10: named supported HRIS/payroll connectors (e.g. Gusto, Rippling), documented automatic sync of new hires and terminations into stakeholder/equity records, sync frequency and field-mapping details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, stakeholders sync from my HRIS/payroll system (e.g. Gusto, Rippling) so new hires and terminations flow into equity records automatically

citations.quote: Connect your HR platform to Vestd and end the manual data shuffle.
